summary.en: Houthi missiles have struck Yemen's presidential palace in Aden, killing five officials, and have also hit a Saudi airport and Saudi-led forces headquarters in Yemen. Iran has sunk two container ships near the strait of Hormuz, expanding the threat to regional shipping, and Saudi diplomats say Iran is encouraging Houthi escalation against the kingdom. US officials are reportedly considering the use of the "mother of all bombs" if fighting resumes. The conflict recorded 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
